meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 装上后，你的聊天机器人就能通过 Discord 机器人接收和发送消息：在 Discord 的私聊或频道里和它对话，它会回复你。技能会负责复制适配器、注册频道、安装依赖并配置凭据。
howto.when: 当你想让聊天机器人支持 Discord，或要求把 Discord 接入现有服务时触发。若正在 /setup 流程中，也可在这里加入 Discord 频道。

say.text: 给我的机器人加上 Discord 频道支持
say.note: 开始复制适配器并配置集成。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord bot 接进来，用我已有的 token
say.note: 会要求你粘贴 Bot Token 并进行验证。

say.text: 我想在 Discord 里和 Claude 聊天，配置一下
say.note: 会引导你完成邀请、获取 DM 频道等。

howto.what_en: Once installed, your chatbot can send and receive messages through a Discord bot: you talk to it in Discord DMs or channels and it replies. The skill copies the adapter, registers the channel, installs the dependency, and configures credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add Discord support to your chatbot or ask to wire Discord into the existing service. It can also be used during the /setup flow to add a Discord channel.

say_en.text: Add Discord channel support to my bot
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and configuring the integration.

say_en.text: Set up the Discord bot using my existing token
say_en.note: Asks you to paste your Bot Token and validates it.

say_en.text: I want to chat with Claude in Discord, set that up
say_en.note: Walks through inviting the bot and resolving the DM channel.
